findings.title: pip --extra-index-url allows dependency confusion
findings.message: This requirements file adds a package index with --extra-index-url. pip installs the highest version found in any index, so a package published on PyPI under the name of a private package can replace it. Use a single index that proxies PyPI, or pin every requirement with --hash.

findings.title: Possible typosquatting: reqeusts resembles the popular PyPI package requests
findings.message: The dependency reqeusts differs from the popular PyPI package requests by one character or separator. Typosquatting packages imitate popular names to be installed by mistake. Check that reqeusts is the intended package.

findings.title: Scope @acme-internal is not mapped to the private registry
findings.message: .npmrc maps other scopes to a private registry, but not @acme-internal: npm fetches @acme-internal/auth from the default registry. If @acme-internal is an internal scope, anyone who registers it on the public registry can supply this package.
